reason: My bookkeeper already handles the documents every month and I barely look at receipts myself, so a monthly sheet and a Monday report is one more thing I'd ignore. I might run the free check out of curiosity, but I wouldn't pay after that.
objection: My staff and I probably won't keep using it once the free part is over. The bookkeeper is already doing this job, so I'd just be paying twice.
would_change_my_mind: If the free check turned up real duplicate or padded invoices from contractors that my bookkeeper missed, enough money to cover the subscription many times over.
